concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-user-manuals-terminal-deprecation-e315-user-manual-charge-the-e315]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured historical e315 charging guide for certified wall charger/Micro-USB, eight-hour initial charge without iPod/iPhone, and five-slot-plus-USB gang charger; not current device support or battery-condition proof.
warnings: The gang-charger headline says up to six e315 units but describes five slots plus an optional USB position; do not imply six physical slots. The parent eVo deprecation page lists a 2024 e315 transaction cutoff.
